title: Defending 160 Versus 200: Why Lucknow Super Giants Needs Two Bowling Playbooks
dek: Defending 160 and defending 200 are different jobs. Why Lucknow Super Giants need two bowling playbooks, and what the league data says each one must achieve.
excerpt: Since 2022, IPL sides defending 160–179 have won less often than sides defending 200 or more. The bowling plan has to change with the total.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: Since 2022 IPL sides defending 160–179 won {{ev:def-l160}}; defending 200 or more, {{ev:def-l200}}.
LSG have won {{ev:def-t}} of matches when batting first since 2022.

sections.heading: Two Totals, Two Jobs
body: A total of 200 lets a bowling side buy wickets with runs. A total of 160 does not: every boundary hurts, and the plan has to start with containment.
Across the IPL since 2022, sides defending 160–179 have won {{ev:def-l160}} of the time; sides defending 200 or more, {{ev:def-l200}}; below 160, {{ev:def-lunder}}.

sections.heading: Lucknow Super Giants' Record Batting First
body: Lucknow Super Giants have won {{ev:def-t}} of their matches batting first since 2022. The team series in the chart shows how that varies by total, where the sample allows.
Their death bowling, which decides most defences, has run at {{ev:defd-team-e2}} an over since 2024 against {{ev:defd-league-e2}} for the league.

sections.heading: The Two Playbooks
body: Defending a big total: attack in the powerplay with catchers up, accept boundaries for wickets, and keep the best death bowler for the eighteenth and twentieth overs.
Defending a modest total: bowl to fields, use the slower bowlers in the middle overs to drag the required rate up, and spread the death overs so no bowler is exposed twice to a set hitter.

sections.heading: Totals Are Relative to Conditions
body: A total of one hundred and seventy at a small, fast ground is a different defence from the same total on a slow pitch. Grouping by raw total ignores venue par scores.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Choose the Playbook at the Innings Break
body: Lucknow Super Giants should decide which playbook to use at the innings break, based on the total relative to the venue's par, not stick to one plan.
Recording which playbook was used and how it went would turn this into a measurable habit.
